title: The Shadows’ Picnic
description: For the few minutes of the eclipse, six shadows have a holiday of their own. They gather under the oak and pass the apples while the chairs sit empty.
alt: Six dark human silhouettes gather around apples and a picnic basket on a red checkered blanket. Empty chairs sit behind them beneath a solar eclipse.
pairing: An imagined eclipse holiday × shadows that picnic on their own
